title: Vacuum Fluctuation-Induced State Switching in Degenerate Optical Parametric Oscillators
summary: Bistable driven-dissipative systems near bifurcations can exhibit noise-activated switching between steady states. Here, we investigate how quantum vacuum fluctuations induce such switching in a biased optical parametric oscillator (OPO), a nonlinear system with intrinsic bistability. We show how microscopic quantum fluctuations driving macroscopic transitions can be controlled with an external bias field that reshapes the OPO steady-state metapotential.
